name: garmin-companion
//: No dependencies and no lockfile — this exists only so one command reaches the three formatters. `worker` and `apps/mobile` install separately, as CI does.

scripts.format: pnpm -C worker run format && pnpm -C apps/mobile run format && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: pnpm -C worker run format:check && pnpm -C apps/mobile run format:check && cargo fmt --all --check
